name: Trickplayer
description: Plex/Jellyfin player as synced thumbnails + subs

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to Plex to sign in, and to your own Plex or Jellyfin server (plex.direct or tailscale ts.net) to download trick-play frames and subtitles.

notes: New in Debugging tools: a picture comparison. It shows the same piece of a frame rendered two ways side by side and asks which looks better — swipe to choose, tap to confirm, answered on the glasses so you never look away.
